BTS DB1B data consists 2 sets files, Coupon Ticket. can downloaded https://www.transtats.bts.gov/DL_SelectFields.asp?Table_ID=289 https://www.transtats.bts.gov/DL_SelectFields.asp?Table_ID=272 respectively. title: Introduction to SKYNET
text: SKYNET creates three types networks extra option: Directed Network - make_net_dir() Undirected Network - make_net_und() Path Network - make_net_path() Metro Network - used argument make_net_dir() make_net_und() International Option - make_net_int() generating network, SKYNET, creates list includes: Dataframe original data (example ) iGraph object Dataframe nodes(airports) statistics generating network SKYNET, possible use following arguments: 1. carriers - groups OD data per carrier TRUE extract backbone network: 1. cap (used pct) - filters network based given percentage (default percentage = 10%) 1. disp (used alpha) - filters network using Serrano et backbone extraction algorithm (default alpha = 0.003)

title: Introduction to SKYNET
text: One SKYNET’s advantages possibility plotting maps without recur external software. Typing net_map(skynet_object) plots ggplot2 based map OD information. Routes drawn great circles, line width scaled passengers, airports sized traffic. specifying group carrier option generating network, net_map() distinguishes carriers different colors. pct argument allows plotting busiest percentage routes. Setting interactive = TRUE returns zoomable leaflet map instead, hovering route airport shows passengers. important point path dataframe created SKYNET.

title: Trip directed network — make_net_trip

title: Trip directed network — make_net_trip
text: object class skynet: list gDir, igraph directed network weighted passengers, netTrip, data frame one row per origin, destination route_type (OD, OT, TT TD) passengers, average fare standard deviation, yield, distance city information, nodes, data frame airport/node statistics (see node_stats).

title: Undirected Network — make_net_und
text: x Data frame disp Uses Serrano's disparity filter (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Disparity_filter_algorithm_of_weighted_network) extract backbone network. alpha Argument disparity filter. cap Filters original data based edge weight. pct Argument cap filter. Value imput percentage. merge set FALSE, keeps parallel edges instead collapsing summing weights. carrier Groups data per carrier OD metro Groups data metropolitan area

title: Undirected Network — make_net_und
text: object class skynet: list gUnd, igraph undirected network weighted passengers, netUnd, data frame one row per route (origin, destination, passengers, average fare standard deviation, yield, distance, year, quarter city information), nodes, data frame airport/node statistics (see node_stats). disp = TRUE cap = TRUE first two elements named gUnd_disp netUnd_disp, gUnd_cap netUnd_cap.

text: Replaced deprecated dplyr::funs()/mutate_all() across(). Replaced deprecated igraph functions (graph.strength(), get.data.frame(), get.vertex.attribute(), subgraph.edges(), average.path.length(), delete.edges(), delete.vertices(), .multiple(), degree.distribution()). net_map() uses linewidth annotation_borders() (ggplot2 >= 4.0.0). download_t100() longer depends RCurl; RCurl removed Imports.
